Frequently Asked Questions

Can I have chickens in Pierce, Colorado?

Yes! Many properties in Pierce are zoned to allow chickens and livestock. Always confirm your parcel’s zoning with the Town of Pierce.

How close is Pierce to major cities?

Pierce is about 25 minutes north of Greeley, 30 minutes from Fort Collins, and just under an hour to Cheyenne, Wyoming.

What types of homes are available in Pierce?

Pierce offers a range of options — from small single-family homes to large acreage properties with shops, barns, and mountain views.
